messages:
taylor (oncall): FYI incident-bot stopped issuing pages to eu-oncall around 2024-11-02T14:18:10Z. No pages for some alerts.
ravi (sre): seeing repeated websocket resets in the logs, grep shows: 
```ERROR websocket read tcp 10.2.4.6:443->10.5.6.7:41234: connection reset by peer
```

sam (ops): took over manual paging to make sure oncall gets notified. Sent manual pages for the highest-severity signals.
priya (eng-infra): initial look shows upstream changed idle TLS timeout on pagergateway. Our reconnect/backoff assumes >=1s idle and immediately tries to reconnect, which triggers a reset loop.
taylor (oncall): which customers were affected? any P1s?
sam (ops): affected: 4 customers, incl 1 P1, 1 P1-candidate escalated. Manual pages acknowledged, engineers engaged.
incident-bot: WARN fallback not active: no HTTP proxy route configured. websocket resets count=47 in 4m
ravi (sre): mitigation plan per runbook: 1) enable HTTP fallback routing for paging; 2) restart incident-bot in eu; 3) temporarily widen backoff window. Who can flip the flag?
sam (ops): i'm on it. Will run the restart and flip the flag, then monitor.
sam (ops): kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/incident-bot-eu
sam (ops): POST https://flags.internal/flip {"key":"PAGING_HTTP_FALLBACK","val":true}
incident-bot: INFO fallback route active, routing via https://pager-proxy.internal
priya (eng-infra): opened quick-fix PR to adjust backoff handling and add jitter + TLS idle detection: https://git.internal/r/redwood/incident-bot/pulls/804
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for incident-bot-eu: 15% -> 100% if stable for 20m
ravi (sre): monitoring: paging success rate recovered to 99.6% in the last 10m. No customer-facing outages but MTTA increased for the P1.
taylor (oncall): please log manual paging timestamps and recipients so we can include in the incident timeline.
sam (ops): logging sent: manual pages at 14:19:02Z, 14:20:15Z, 14:21:09Z, 14:22:50Z. P1 contact confirmed at 14:23:12Z.
priya (eng-infra): post-incident tasks: merge PR, rollout 100%, add feature-flag to disable reconnect optimization, create alert for >10 websocket resets/min, add runbook step to test HTTP fallback weekly.
ravi (sre): impact blurb for later: auto-paging failed for 4 customers between 14:18:10Z-14:22:00Z due to websocket reset loop after upstream TLS change. Manual paging prevented missed escalations; increased MTTA for one P1. No telemetry/data loss.
taylor (oncall): assigning postmortem owner: taylor. Will draft initial incident doc and schedule retro.
sam (ops): tagging @support-team for customer follow-ups on the P1.
priya (eng-infra): thanks — i'll watch the canary finish and then promote. Also adding a small test to CI that simulates 0s TLS idle and verifies fallback.
deploy-bot: Canary complete: promoted to 100% across eu cluster
incident-bot: EVENT incident-1714567890 recorded
taylor (oncall): closing thread here for coordination; will update the incident doc with the manual paging list and timeline. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
